name: Freiburg im Breisgau

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official FreiGIS HTML loaded and referenced the current masterportal JavaScript.

Current portal configuration identified parcel search, municipal ownership/contact, EPSG:25832 map CRS, and WFS search URL /wfs/verma_alkis/alkis_kora_wfs with typeName ms:flst and property ms:flstkz.
WFS capabilities listed ms:flst and allowed GeoJSON output format application/json; subtype=geojson; charset=utf-8, with the service endpoint on geoportal.freiburg.de.
Schema listed the_geom and native fields including flstkz; no unsafe owner/contact/title fields were requested.
Rejected because application/json was not an allowed output format; this was treated as a format error, not absence.
Returned three GeoJSON polygon features. The first feature, native flstkz 085710-000-03473/0000, contains the transformed exact WUP point; only its identity and geometry were retained.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:25832 declared by returned GeoJSON; native coordinates are projected easting/northing pairs.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Not applicable; direct native flstkz identity 085710-000-03473/0000.

qualification.reason: A real anonymous municipal WFS exact-point polygon is verified, but independent serial review is required before any adapter qualification or admission.

scopeLimits: One bounded WFS response and one exact-point containment result are not citywide coverage evidence.
The initial unsupported output format is recorded as a request error, not as a service miss.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS verification disablement were used.
Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The current city FreiGIS configuration, WFS schema, CRS, and one containing parcel are verified. Citywide completeness and production adapter behavior remain unresolved.
